payload.summary: VAL_REVIEW ran as a single-vendor convergence lane (claude_code, min_quorum 1) and converged in one round with two advisory findings and zero blocking findings. Both findings were fixed in validation-report.md: the mirror-sync claim was stale after the IMPL_REVIEW doc fix (the mirrors were re-synced and install.sh --check now exits 0), and the scenario mapping now names the test covering cheap-path-dropped-on-comments. Open ledger items 2-4 were re-verified as resolved or accepted.

decisions.title: Fix advisory validation findings even though they do not block
decisions.rationale: The report is the durable evidence artifact; a stale claim in it is worse than the cost of a one-line edit.
